title: Control Ultimate Edition
summary: Adds DLSS Ray Reconstruction with specular motion vectors and optional HDR DLSS frame generation through OptiScaler.
notes: Requires DirectX 12, an NVIDIA RTX GPU, in-game DLSS enabled and ReShade 6.7.0 or newer with full add-on support.
Place the addon and release nvngx_dlssd.dll beside Control_DX12.exe; load only one RenoDX addon. Select Ray Reconstruction under Ray Tracing in the ReShade overlay.

Optional DLSS frame generation requires supported hardware and HDR enabled in Windows and Control. Install OptiScaler as winmm.dll alongside ReShade's dxgi.dll, with Streamline runtimes under OptiScaler/streamline/.

OptiScaler.ini: [Upscalers] Dx12Upscaler=dlss; [FrameGen] Enabled=true, FGInput=Upscaler, FGOutput=DLSSG; [fakenvapi] ForceReflex=2; [DLSSG] UseGamesReflexMarkers=false. Leave HDR overrides at auto. Enable the addon's HDR10 bridge and restart; leave it off for SDR.
